metas.description: Elf mage Frieren and her fellow adventurers have defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land. But Frieren will long outlive the rest of her former party. How will she come to understand what life means to the people arou...

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2022 · Spy x Family
metas.description: A spy on an undercover mission gets married and adopts a child as part of his cover. His wife and daughter have secrets of their own, and all three must strive to keep together.

metas.description: A quiet loner and the popular girl at school find common ground, making their cosplay dreams come true.
